about: Known causes of failing verbs and checks. clossys heal matches an incident record's `<stage>\n<signature>` against `match` (first match wins), runs the named remedy (remedies.ts) and re-runs the step once. Every cause has a guard: a rule in scripts/rules/registry.json whose check fails on the cause's violation fixture; check:heal refuses a cause without one. A record after guard_landed is a REPEAT.

causes.blocker: a test-fixture child outlived its killed run; spawn fixtures through spawnFixture so teardown ends the whole process group
causes.note: A test-fixture child process outlived a killed test run and held a build slot for two hours.

causes.blocker: the root check was held to a fixed exit 0; it is judged as same exit as base, measured in the same environment
causes.note: A root check that is already red on the base was required to exit 0, so the mechanical run refused a unit that added no red.

causes.blocker: a timeout under load is noise until it fails alone and passes on the base
causes.note: Load-noise timeouts were read as new reds.

causes.match: ^fold[^\n]*\n[\s\S]*(?:stale|non-fast-forward|not a fast-forward|behind origin|does not match origin|refusing to fold)
causes.blocker: the fold compared a stale local ref; fetch the branch, then compare
causes.note: A stale local branch ref made the fold refuse.

causes.match: ^(?:packet|lint|accept|validate)[^\n]*\n[\s\S]*(?:two expectations|contradictory expectation|both exit # and same exit as base)
causes.blocker: the packet states two expectations for one validation command; the planner rewrites it with exactly one (packet lint refuses it until then)
causes.note: A packet both required exit 0 and allowed same exit as base for one command. No remedy: choosing either expectation by code would either relax a check or refuse a sound unit.
